# Genre Cut Style Guide: Horror
- Build the stillness before the fright in long Cuts, then land the shock on a sudden change (a cut away).
- Use detail Cuts lit only in part out of the dark.
- Design the uneasy elements, such as the empty space behind a person or a corridor, as their own Cuts.
- Break the audience's sense of safety with unannounced Cut changes.
